verdict.line: You lose if you flash E-in on a loaded Q-E combo; you win if you chain Q3 onto a trade he started.

brief.thesis: Ornn's entire lane threat is tied to his Q (Volcanic Rupture) and E (Searing Charge) coming off cooldown together, and both are single-target skillshots with no AoE bailout. Aatrox's Q (The Darkin Blade) has a 25000 range and three stacking swings that out-damage anything Ornn throws in an isolated trade, so if you force fights on his cooldowns instead of his, the 49.7% win rate over 1533 games tilts in your favor.

theirWindow.when: both Q and E are up
theirWindow.what: He can slow you with Q (Volcanic Rupture, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cooldown) then close the gap with E (Searing Charge, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s cooldown) to land a wall-shockwave knockup. If he lands the Q slow first, back off instead of trading — the follow-up E knockup chains into a free W (Bellows Breath) application of Brittle.

yourWindow.when: his Q or E is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and unload Q (The Darkin Blade, 14/12/10/8/6s cooldown) stacks plus E (Umbral Dash) for the on-hit heal — without the Q slow or E gap-close he has no way to punish your dash-in, so this is when solo kills happen.

start.why: 75.3% pick rate at 48.9% win over 1354 games — the sustain and AD let you win extended trades where his Q slow would otherwise punish you.

boots.why: 51% win rate over 904 games; the tenacity shortens how long his E knockup and Q slow lock you down, which is the entire window he needs to land his combo.

core.why: 65.2% win over 69 games in the top path; the shield and burst let you punish the exact moment his Q/E are down.
Pairs with Eclipse for all-in trades where you need the crit-proc healing to outlast his Living Forge bonus armor/MR.
Converts his magic poke damage into a damage-over-time you can heal through with E (Umbral Dash) and passive Deathbringer Stance procs.

situational.when: he builds armor early off Living Forge and you need the shred to keep trading through it
fights go long and you need the cooldown haste to get more Q (The Darkin Blade) swings per trade
you're ahead and want to close distance faster before his Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow lands

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades are where you win this lane — stacking Conqueror through repeated Q swings and E dashes out-heals his magic poke over a long fight.

summoners.why: 60.6% pick rate at 49.8% win — Ignite seals the solo-kill advantage this matchup already gives you once you catch him out of his Q/E window.

playing.title: Trade only on his cooldowns
playing.detail: Never walk up when both Q (Volcanic Rupture) and E (Searing Charge) are available — wait for one to be down, then commit Q (The Darkin Blade) stacks.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Ignite-R all-in
playing.detail: Once he hits 6, he can combo Ignite into R (Call of the Forge God) for a slow-and-Brittle setup. Play with extra spacing right as he levels up near his cooldown windows.

playing.title: Hold E for the gap, not the poke
playing.detail: Umbral Dash's passive heal only triggers on champion damage, so save the dash to close distance after his E charge misses or whiffs into terrain.

playing.title: Stack Q before committing
playing.detail: The Darkin Blade's three swings each hit different areas — bait his E charge with your first swing, then land swings two and three once he's locked into his animation.

playing.title: Watch for the knockup off terrain
playing.detail: His E only creates a shockwave if he hits a wall while charging — if you're near lane terrain, back off the second he starts the charge animation.

playing.title: Save R for extended skirmishes
playing.detail: World Ender's fear and healing boost are wasted on a short trade; use it when a fight will run long enough for the takedown-extension to matter.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown reads, trade-window timing, and overall tactical plan are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo as well as when he reaches level 6 to use his Ignite – Call of the Forge God (R) combo. Keep some distance while using your abilities come off cooldown to gain control over lane.
